scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms, Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
The worker must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
The worker’s monthly salary must not exceed ₹25,000
The worker’s service period is fixed for two years
Children must be studying in Class I to Class XII at the time of admission
The scheme allows up to three girls and two boys per worker
The child’s name must be mentioned on the worker’s Ration Card or ESI Card
Applications must be submitted on or before 31 December of the respective session
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time financial assistance of ₹3,000 for children in Class I‑IV and ₹4,000 for children in Class V‑XII.
documents_required: Ration Card or ESI Card of the worker
